## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Boston, United States. It starts at 1 Central Wharf.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Want to get friendly with some fish, or maybe learn a little about our oceans? Flash this smartphone ticket and cruise on into the New England Aquarium.
>
> Watch the ocean life swimming around you, from seals to sea lions, penguins, sea turtles and jellyfish. Touch the stingrays in their pool, and try and catch the octopus when he's changing color – that's a sight you don't see every day.
>
> Behold Boston's most visited tourist attraction, the impressive New England Aquarium, where the star attraction is a 200,000-gallon giant ocean exhibit! Don't miss the new octopus Tatoosh, who resides in the Olympic Coast Exhibit, also home to many other marine animals from this region of the Pacific Northwest.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €37.41. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 196 ratings and 65 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
